description: This source file handles entity events in the game, including death, damage, movement, and environmental interactions, and manages associated sounds, visual effects, and game state updates.

methods.name: CG_Obituary
methods.description: Handles displaying death messages and related effects based on the means of death and team affiliations.

methods.name: CG_PainEvent
methods.description: Plays pain sounds and updates pain-related visual effects for a game entity.

methods.name: CG_OnPlayerWeaponChange
methods.description: Updates HUD and weapon state when the player changes weapons.

methods.name: CG_Rocket_UpdateArmouryMenu
methods.description: Refreshes the weapon upgrade menu UI if it is currently visible.

methods.name: CG_OnMapRestart
methods.description: Resets UI elements and hides scores when the map restarts.

methods.name: CG_Momentum
methods.description: Notifies the player of generated momentum based on entity state.

methods.name: CG_EntityEvent
methods.description: Processes entity events such as sounds, visual effects, and game state changes based on entity state and event type.

methods.name: CG_CheckEvents
methods.description: Checks and triggers entity events at the correct game frame time, including handling special event-only entities and event riding.
